prompt: In a TypeScript app, send an add_cart_item command to the owner-scoped cart aggregate at owner/{ownerId}/cart, wait for the snapshot, then read the updated cart state.
expectedBehavior: Imports CommandClient, SnapshotQueryClient, CommandHeaders, and CommandStage from @ahoo-wang/wow-client and Fetcher from @ahoo-wang/fetcher
Binds ownerId through urlParams.path (or a resource-attribution interceptor) instead of hard-coding it into basePath
Sets CommandHeaders.WAIT_STAGE to CommandStage.SNAPSHOT before reading state
Reads state with getStateById (or singleState with filter.eq on aggregateId) using the aggregateId from the CommandResult

prompt: Page PAID orders whose createdAt is yesterday in the Asia/Shanghai zone, 20 per page, newest first, returning only state objects.
expectedBehavior: Builds the filter with filter.and, filter.eq, and filter.yesterday using zoneId 'Asia/Shanghai' rather than hand-written JSON or deprecated Condition helpers
Sorts with desc('state.createdAt') and paginates with pagination { index: 1, size: 20 }
Calls pagedState on a SnapshotQueryClient (or one created from QueryClientFactory)
